articles.headline: Why is Salesforce the Worst-Performing Dow Jones Stock?
articles.summary: Salesforce stock has plunged sharply in the past few years and is the top laggard in the Dow Jones Index as growth concerns remain
articles._summary: CRM stock has fallen in the past few years amid concerns about its revenue and market share growth. Most recently, the retreat has been because of the ongoing SaaSPocalypse concerns. SaaSPocalypse is the fear that artificial intelligence agents will ultimately disrupt and take market share from software companies. These AI tools are expected to become more powerful over time. Just this week, OpenAI confirmed that its AI tool had successfully hacked Hugging Face .
articles._zh_headline: 为什么 Salesforce 是表现最差的道琼斯股票？
articles._zh_summary: 由于对其收入和市场份额增长的担忧，CRM 股票在过去几年中一直在下跌。最近，撤退是因为持续存在的 SaaSPocalypse 担忧。 SaaSPocalypse 是对人工智能代理最终会颠覆并夺取软件公司市场份额的担忧。随着时间的推移，这些人工智能工具预计将变得更加强大。就在本周，OpenAI 确认其 AI 工具已成功破解 Hugging Face。

articles.headline: Elon Musk Built Tesla and SpaceX While Working Over 100-Hour Weeks. He Says 'Vacations Will Kill You' and the Reasons Behind It Are as Chaotic as You'd Expect.
articles.summary: Elon Musk, founder of SpaceX and CEO of Tesla, is known for working over 100 hours a week and linking it to vacation disasters.
articles._summary: Musk said building his companies sometimes required more than 100 hours weekly, and his workload later climbed to about 120 hours after he bought Twitter . "Go to sleep, I wake up, work, go to sleep, work, do that 7 days a week," he said, speaking at the Ron Baron Conference in November 2022. His rare breaks became part of his work mythology. Musk said one week off coincided with explosions involving Orbital Sciences and Virgin Galactic vehicles. During another, a SpaceX rocket exploded.
articles._zh_headline: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 每周工作 100 多个小时，打造了 Tesla 和 SpaceX。他说“假期会杀了你”，其背后的原因正如你所想象的那样混乱。
articles._zh_summary: 马斯克表示，创建自己的公司有时每周需要花费 100 多个小时，而在他收购 Twitter 后，他的工作量后来攀升至约 120 小时。他在 2022 年 11 月举行的 Ron Baron 会议上发表讲话时说道：“睡觉、起床、工作、睡觉、工作，每周 7 天都是这样。”他罕见的休息时间成为了他工作神话的一部分。马斯克表示，休假一周恰逢轨道科学公司和维珍银河公司的飞行器发生爆炸。另一次，SpaceX 的一枚火箭发生爆炸。

articles._summary: The U.S. ETF industry’s hottest product is no longer just a blockbuster fund, it’s the copycat. And interestingly, a successful ETF doesn’t just attract assets, it spawns an entire category.
